name: US–China / Taiwan
value: PLA area-denial drills; Trump–Xi at APEC next
summary: Taiwan says China is running carrier-led area-denial drills in the Western Pacific; Trump–Xi meeting due at APEC
state: On 10 Nov Taiwan's defence minister Wellington Koo said China is running area-denial drills in the Western Pacific involving the Liaoning carrier group, after Taiwan reported more than 100 Chinese naval and coast guard ships around the region the week before (ThePrint, citing Reuters). China has not declared any drills. Trump is expected to meet Xi at APEC in Shenzhen in the week after 10 Nov. No blockade, quarantine, clash or severed channel was found as of 12 Nov.
for_you: No direct effect for most people now. Tension around Taiwan can disrupt shipping, flights and chip supply chains; travellers should check FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Large-scale PLA activity: carrier-led area-denial drills, 100+ ships reported (Watch); no blockade or clash

sources.title: ThePrint (Reuters) — Taiwan says China is conducting area-denial drills in Western Pacific

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
